description: This Java interface defines a contract for representing either a sent signal with an acknowledgement or a dropped signal within the messaging system of the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides a method to monitor the send result, which can be an acknowledgement or indication of message drop, utilizing a converter for exception to acknowledgement handling.

methods.name: monitorAndAcknowledge
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing a CompletionStage of CommandResponse, representing the acknowledgement or response to a sent signal, or empty if the signal was dropped. It takes an ExceptionToAcknowledgementConverter to convert exceptions into acknowledgements.
